text: The pager rotation for Godwit-4 is run by Lucia Jaramillo; alerts page them first.
Unlike Avocet-8, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Curlew-5 is the Prism team. Nobody should assume the owner of Curlew-5 applies to Avocet-8, the owner differs.
Plover-8 was granted a budget of $1365k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.
The service Plover-8 takes traffic on port 9191, and the port is fixed across every environment.

Unlike Curlew-5, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Dunlin-3 is the Ledger team. Nobody should assume the owner of Dunlin-3 applies to Curlew-5, the owner differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Pages from Plover-8 land on the pager rotation of Jolene Ivanova before anyone else. An older draft of this note was archived.
Source for Curlew-5 is written in Erlang; no other language is allowed in its repository. An older draft of this note was archived.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Godwit-4, which is 3900 requests per minute.
Avocet-8 has one owner, the Anvil team, which approves each release and keeps the runbook current.

Unlike Plover-8, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Avocet-8 is $2990k. Nobody should assume the budget of Avocet-8 applies to Plover-8, the budget differs.
Curlew-5 listens on port 5669; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Osprey-8 listens on port 8832; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Avocet-8, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Plover-8 is January 22, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Plover-8 applies to Avocet-8, the retirement date differs.
Godwit-4 reaches its retirement date on September 26, 2027, so every consumer has to migrate before then. An older draft of this note was archived.
The primary datacenter of Dunlin-3 is Hanoi; failover is handled by operations. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Dunlin-3 reaches its retirement date on July 17, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
